```lean
theorem lg_target (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : (a + b) * (1 / a + 1 / b) ≥ 4 := by
  have h1 : (a + b) * (1 / a + 1 / b) = 2 + a / b + b / a :=
    by rw [mul_add, add_mul, mul_inv_left, mul_inv_right, add_assoc]; ring
  have h2 : a / b + b / a ≥ 2 := Real.add_inv_self_ge_two ha hb
  have h3 : 2 + (a / b + b / a) ≥ 2 + 2 := add_right_mono h2
  exact le_trans h3 (le_refl 4)
```
